premise.claim: The repo pins ossf/scorecard-action at v2.4.4 (2d1146689b8cda280b9bc96326124645441f03bc) and a newer release v2.5.0 exists upstream.
premise.evidence: git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-action.git: refs/tags/v2.5.0 -> 46dc3187 (tag object) -> fa7117db (commit); base workflow pins 2d11466 = v2.4.4 commit. results/l1-report.json check C2 (run against head) and scratch ls-remote output in README.

findings.claim: Under any run of .github/workflows/sonarcloud.yaml, the with: inputs exclude_checks ("Pinned-Dependencies") and exclude_paths ("vendor/**") should be honored by the action, but they are silently ignored: scorecard-action declares (and reads) neither INPUT_EXCLUDE_CHECKS nor INPUT_EXCLUDE_PATHS in v2.4.4 or v2.5.0 (options/env.go lists only repo_token, results_file, results_format, publish_results, file_mode, internal_*).
findings.evidence: results/l1-report.json check C3 (WARN, undeclared: exclude_checks, exclude_paths) plus git grep at both pins; bites documented in results/l1-bite-check.txt (bite C with --strict-inputs).

acceptance.contract: The workflow pins scorecard-action at the exact commit of the upstream v2.5.0 annotated tag (comment and SHA agree).
acceptance.evidence: results/l1-report.json: tag v2.5.0 -> fa7117db83c52d787ae5a89f350999701505d78e = workflow pin.

acceptance.contract: Every with: input the workflow passes that was declared by scorecard-action v2.4.4 is still declared by v2.5.0 (no input dropped/renamed across the bump); action.yaml input sets of both pins are identical.
acceptance.evidence: results/l1-report.json: dropped: none; prev declared == head declared (diff of action.yaml shows only description/results_format wording + docker tag).

acceptance.contract: .github/workflows/sonarcloud.yaml parses as YAML at the PR head.
All required inputs of scorecard-action v2.5.0 (results_file, results_format) are supplied by the workflow.
The docker image referenced by the pinned action.yaml matches the pinned version (docker://ghcr.io/ossf/scorecard-action:v2.5.0).
